title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Insurer Q&A: Storage Days Under Insurer Review
content:
**Rule.** On a Repair Estimates & Appointments insurance-claim booking, the insurer's re-inspections keep the vehicle under its review for longer: after the grace days, a booking carrying two or more estimate revisions adds **2** calendar days for which the insurer answers, a booking carrying exactly one estimate revision adds **1**, and a booking with no estimate revision adds none.

**Questions and answers**

*Which revisions are counted?* The estimate revisions recorded on the booking, each a re-inspection with its own revision number.

*Are these business days?* No — they are calendar days, following on after the grace days.

*The booking has three revisions.* Two or more: 2 calendar days.

| Estimate revisions on the booking | Calendar days the insurer answers for after the grace days |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | 1 |
| 2 or more | 2 |

Hypothetical illustration: where the grace period ends on a Tuesday and the booking carries one estimate revision, the insurer also answers for the Wednesday.
